item.description:
Thanks for sharing this link, although I often discover this site through Smashing Magazine, I must have missed this article.

I never knew about the double-margin float bug (or at least the fix), I just always halve the margin stated in conditionally commented stylesheets.

This article is now bookmarked. Thanks!

Thought I would share this link along the same lines but written nearly a year before the link you supplied – http://www.virtuosimedia.com/tutorials/ultimate-ie6-cheatsheet-how-to-fix-25-internet-explorer-6-bugs
